multiplechoiceresponse.p: What do the NIST AI RMF's four functions describe?

choice.div: An operating loop: govern, map, measure, manage.
A list of prohibited AI uses.

div.p: The framework describes practice. Legal obligations come from law and sector rules.

multiplechoiceresponse.p: Which statement is safe to make publicly about compliance?

choice.div: "We maintain a risk register, test identified harms, and review quarterly; the legal position is being confirmed by counsel."
"Our product is fully compliant with all AI laws."
"We are certified by the AI framework."

div.p: Describe evidence and scope. A blanket compliance claim invites a challenge you cannot support.

multiplechoiceresponse.p: Where do binding obligations for your deployment come from?

choice.div: The law and sector rules that apply to your organization and use, confirmed for your case.

div.p: Frameworks inform practice; obligations come from applicable law and regulation.

choiceresponse.p: Which belong under "govern"? Select all that apply.

choice.div: Who decides and who is accountable.
The policy that says what may be assisted.

div.p: Governance is decision rights, policy and records — not model parameters or branding.
